joined.title: ServiceNow saw July's overrun coming
joined.subtitle: Opex actuals (SAP) x Eng headcount (Workday) x cloud capacity incidents (ServiceNow) - indexed, Sep = 100

annotation.label: incidents triple, headcount flat, spend follows

insight.headline: Cloud capacity incidents tripled in June — one month before July's $1.44M opex overrun
insight.detail: Joining ServiceNow's capacity-alert queue to SAP actuals shows incidents jumping from 16 to 34 in June while Engineering headcount in Workday stayed flat at ~420 FTE, so July's $862K AWS true-up was capacity strain, not hiring. SAP only sees the spend after it posts, Workday only proves the team didn't grow, and ServiceNow's early-warning spike never reaches Finance on its own.
insight.action: Add the ServiceNow cloud-capacity alert count to the driver-based forecast model as a one-month leading indicator, and flag June-style spikes to James Whitfield before the commit trues up.
